channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: One Cop Dead and Thirteen Injured as Surajkund Fair Ride Collapses in Haryana
item.description: A ride malfunction at Surajkund Mela killed an inspector during evacuation and injured 13 fairgoers, raising safety concerns.

item.title: India’s Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 Explained: Here’s What Will Change from April 1
item.description: From mandatory four-way segregation to digital tracking and stricter penalties, India’s new waste rules seek systemic change.

item.title: Elavenil Valarivan Clinches Gold Medal in Women’s 10m Air Rifle at Asian Championships with Stellar Dominant Performance
item.description: Indian shooter Elavenil Valarivan claimed gold in the women’s 10m air rifle event, with Meghana Sajjanar taking bronze as India secured team gold at the Asian Championships.

item.title: Belagavi, Karnataka: Three Men Allegedly Posing as Journalists Plant Hidden Cameras in Woman Officer’s Home, Demand ₹50 Lakh; Probe On
item.description: Three men allegedly posed as journalists, secretly filmed a woman government officer at home and attempted to extort ₹50 lakh before being arrested.

item.title: Bengaluru Metro Protest: BJP MP Tejasvi Surya Detained Amid Fare Hike Row
item.description: A protest against Bengaluru Metro’s proposed fare hike briefly led to the detention of BJP MP Tejasvi Surya, reigniting debate on public transport affordability, democratic dissent and policing.

item.title: Gujarat Factory Used 300 Litres Real Milk to Produce 1,800 Litres Fake Milk Daily for 5 Years
item.description: Police in Gujarat have busted a factory that produced chemically adulterated milk and buttermilk for years, endangering public health.

item.title: People of Purpose: Inside Savita Mundhe’s 18-Year Journey of Building Sustainable Education Models at JSW Foundation
item.description: Savita Mundhe's strategic shift from donations to long-term JSW programs turned skeptical communities into partners achieving 60% learning growth.

item.title: Bomb Threat Emails Warn “Delhi Will Become Khalistan”, Ten Schools Evacuated Across Delhi Amid Security High Alert
item.description: Delhi authorities launched emergency evacuations and heightened security after threatening emails targeted 10 schools and warned of an explosion inside Parliament.

item.title: No Consent, No Camera: Goa Police to Detain Offenders for Non-Consensual Beach Photographs of Tourists
item.description: After repeated complaints and viral videos, Goa Police have begun detaining offenders to protect tourists and the state’s global image.

item.title: 255 Ate Breakfast, Over 100 Hospitalised: Food Poisoning Exposes Negligence at Andhra Pradesh Tribal Hostel
item.description: More than 100 students of a tribal welfare hostel in Andhra Pradesh were hospitalised with food poisoning after consuming contaminated breakfast, prompting an official probe.
